title: registerMember
description: Parses the name and email, then in one transaction builds the member with `Member.register` and saves it through `MemberRepository.add`, which refuses a taken email. It saves `MemberRegistered` to the outbox in that transaction and runs the relay once it commits.

title: addTool
description: Parses the name and trims the description, then in one transaction builds the tool with `Tool.add`, in good condition, and saves it through `ToolRepository.add`. It saves `ToolAdded` to the outbox in that transaction and runs the relay once it commits.

title: reportDamage
description: Parses the note, then in one transaction loads the tool through `ToolRepository.get`, has `Tool.reportDamage` record the report, which refuses a tool that already needs repair (TL-LEND-INV02), and saves the tool whole, leaving any loan alone. It saves `DamageReported` to the outbox in that transaction and runs the relay once it commits. The librarian's endpoint and the event handler TL-LEND-PO01-H both invoke it.

title: markToolRepaired
description: In one transaction loads the tool through `ToolRepository.get`, has `Tool.markRepaired` set it to good and clear its damage report, which refuses a tool that does not need repair (TL-LEND-SP04), and saves the tool whole. It saves `ToolRepaired` to the outbox in that transaction and runs the relay once it commits.

title: borrowTool
description: Checks the IDs, then in one transaction loads the member and the tool through their repositories, refusing an unknown one, and the member's and the tool's active loans through `LoanRepository`; `Loan.open` runs the remaining checks in order and works out the due date, and the loan is saved through `LoanRepository.add`. It saves `LoanOpened` to the outbox in that transaction and runs the relay once it commits.

title: returnTool
description: Requires a valid condition, then in one transaction that touches only the loan loads it through `LoanRepository.get`, has `Loan.recordReturn` record the return once and say whether it was late, and saves the loan whole. It saves `ToolReturned` to the outbox in that transaction and runs the relay once it commits, which hands the event to TL-LEND-PO01-H; the return stands whatever that handler does, and an event whose handler fails stays undelivered for the next relay run.

title: renewLoan
description: In one transaction that touches only the loan, loads it through `LoanRepository.get`, has `Loan.renew` refuse a returned, overdue or already renewed loan and move the due date on 14 days with `renewedDueDate` (TL-LEND-DS01-SV), and saves the loan whole. It saves `LoanRenewed` to the outbox in that transaction and runs the relay once it commits.

title: remindMember
description: In one transaction that touches only the loan, loads it through `LoanRepository.get`, has `Loan.recordReminder` refuse a returned loan or one already reminded (TL-LEND-INV08) and record the time, and saves the loan whole. It saves `MemberReminded` to the outbox in that transaction and runs the relay once it commits. Only the event handler TL-LEND-PO02-H invokes it.
